description: Early-stage PM writing for buyers who already believe in sustainability — the gap is behavior, not conviction, so every claim leans on a usage number even when the sample is thin.
constraints: cite a real, even small, customer usage number instead of a study
name what was tried before and did not stick
antiPatterns: awareness framed as the whole plan
rules: open with what changed in the reader's environment (budget, regulation, target)
close with the objection the reader will hear from their own boss

coreReasoningSignature.narrativeProse: Surfaces a counter-intuitive finding from customer usage data and ties it directly to the reader's next decision, never to a slogan.

argumentDevelopmentSignature.developmentProse: Opens with what changed for the reader, grounds the finding in thin-but-real usage data, names what was already tried and failed, then closes on the internal objection.
